                    int slot,

        Constructs a toggle button gadget.
        Parameters:
        gui - the GUI to add the gadget to
        slot - the GUI slot to display the gadget in
        value - the initial value for the gadget
        trueTexture - the icon texture to display when the gadget is set to true
        falseTexture - the icon texture to display when the gadget is set to false
        callback - the code to run when the gadget is changed by a player
